editorial.blurb: Dimmi Dimmi Corner Italian is a cozy, dimly lit gem delivering consistently excellent Italian fare that's earning its social media buzz through impeccable service and standout dishes that keep guests coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive right when they open (4 PM) on weekdays to snag a table without a reservation, or call ahead—the tavern-style pizzas and vodka stuffed shells are worth the effort.
